transforms.native_to_scene: Scale 1000, rotate X +90deg: native metres [x,elevation,y] -> mm [x,-y,elevation].
transforms.asic: Four original PCB-5 clones retain source geometry; their complete group is translated for a separate recording-side cluster. No ASIC distribution or mating adapter is invented.
transforms.separated_view: Inspection only: FPGA +8mm, interposer +10mm, XEM +20mm. Registered nominal view removes these display offsets.
transforms.display_layout: Rigid 180 degree Z rotations of compact and complete registered host groups point source micro-HDMI ports into the gap. Host visible bounds centered at X70/Y0 mm. Compact group translated to leave 70 mm between its maxX and full host minX; required display clearance >=65 mm. ASIC group translated left of compact with18 mm clearance. These are illustration positions, not physical stack or enclosure dimensions.

scope: Unchanged native board CAD, with full registered host geometry and native interposer pad/silkscreen/soldermask surfaces. Compact electronics and host stack remain separate and linked by an illustrative micro-HDMI cable. No ASIC die, distribution adapter, missing vendor body, standoff or routing invented; hardware qualification unchanged.

cable.representation: Illustrative curved jacket mesh; no qualified plug, physical cable length, bend radius or mating datum.
cable.separate_source: FPGA V41 node J3 world maxX face center after rigid group rotation.
cable.combined_source: V7 J3 source-model mouth point native metres[.0994,.00277,.1058], transformed with the combined model.
cable.host_target: Interposer V4 node J600 world minX face center after rigid group rotation; follows interposer inspection separation.
cable.source_reference_scope: Nominal connector-bound anchors retain the actual source ports. Cable geometry and overall spacing communicate the architecture only.

host_detail.policy: Full registered BRK/XEM tessellations and original native V4 component/surface triangles. No QEM, clustering, decimation or quantization.

interposer.verification: Every component reference has the same triangle count and registered bounds as the earlier full V4 model. Registered substrate bounds are unchanged.
interposer.processing: Merge primitives by material within each original mesh, retain native float32 positions, normals, material assignments and triangles; apply existing V4 Z-up/mm registration.
interposer.limits: Existing component sources mix vendor geometry, generic packages and dimension-derived nominal envelopes. Newer Power Foundation V1 is separate schematic work, not placed V4 hardware.
interposer.viewer_material_policy: Render native transparent substrate, soldermask and silkscreen materials as opaque with depth writing to avoid sorting haze. GLB material assignments and bytes are unchanged.

official_source_omissions.BRK8305: Official STEP omits MC4–MC9 header bodies and S1/J2/J6 bodies. No replacement bodies invented.
official_source_omissions.XEM8305: Upstream official-STEP conversion omits decorative silkscreen, prepreg and K-DOT pickup subtrees. Full GLB retains all remaining input tessellation.

host_detail.attribution: Opal Kelly authored official BRK8305/XEM8305 models; native V4 retains original project and model-source provenance.

inspection.behavior: Interposer focus hides surrounding models and opens Top; Bottom exposes the underside; other focus controls restore the assembly.
